verdict.rationale: Payroll lifecycle webhooks are a fair question for a payroll platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes API Central, which offers API templates, OAuth/OpenID Connect and "real-time data sharing," plus app-integration marketing. Nothing documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions for payroll processed, employee onboarded or payment failed, and pull APIs are an adjacent capability that earns no credit here.
